patterns.note: Full-bleed, dark background hero with central, oversized typography and minimal fixed footer navigation.
Extreme contrast in type scale between the dominant, elegant display heading and the small, utilitarian navigation/copyright text.
Predominantly dark (black/deep blue) background with stark white typography, accented by vibrant, neon-like glowing elements.
A multi-stage loading sequence (spinner, percentage) followed by a dramatic reveal of large text and complex, abstract, animated 3D-like elements that continuously move and glow.
A single, immersive hero section dominates the initial view, acting as a gateway or brand statement rather than an informational block.

technique_notes: A pre-loader sequence with a spinner and percentage counter transitions into the main hero content.
The hero features large, static text overlaid on a dynamic, full-screen background.

Complex, abstract, glowing 3D-like elements are rendered and animated, likely using a canvas or video hero, to create a sense of depth and motion around the central text. These elements appear to be light sources or energy fields, continuously animating with a fluid motion.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, elegant display headings (~8-10x body) with a very light weight, contrasted by small, standard-weight sans-serif body/navigation text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero section, with content centered and ample negative space.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly immersive, full-screen animated hero that uses abstract, glowing 3D-like elements to create a dynamic and almost ethereal backdrop for minimal, oversized typography. This creates a strong, almost art-installation-like brand statement rather than a typical informational hero.
